Wire Up the Buttons and Play!

Connect every button to the right function and run your quiz!

What we're doing: We connect every button to the right function so that tapping them actually does something. Then we run the program and play our quiz!

🧩 Analogy You've built a circuit with light bulbs and switches — now you connect the wires so flipping each switch turns on the right light.

A) Start Button

  1. Find the CLICKED event handler block for start_btn (it's in the M5UI section)
  2. Inside the handler, add these blocks in order:
    • set score to 0
    • set current_round to 1
    • call setup_round()
    • game_page screen_load
💡 Why reset to 1? Every time you tap START, we reset current_round to 1 so the game begins fresh from the first question. We also reset score to 0 so you start with a clean slate.

B) Four Answer Buttons

  1. Find the CLICKED handler for answer_btn1. Inside: call check_answer(1)
  2. answer_btn2 handler: call check_answer(2)
  3. answer_btn3 handler: call check_answer(3)
  4. answer_btn4 handler: call check_answer(4)
💡 Why 1, 2, 3, 4? Each button calls the same function but passes a different number (1, 2, 3, or 4). That's how check_answer knows which button was pressed! The number matches the index in current_choices — button 1 = first answer, button 2 = second answer, etc.

C) Try Again Button

  1. Find the CLICKED handler for try_again_btn. Inside: title_page screen_load

D) Final Checks

  1. In the Loop section, make sure M5.update is there — it keeps the touch screen alive!
  2. At the end of Setup, make sure title_page screen_load is present — it shows the start screen first.

E) Run It!

  1. Click the Run Once button at the bottom
  2. Watch your Tab5 — you should see the title screen. Tap START, answer 8 questions, see your score!
✅ What you should see: All six buttons are now wired up. Tap START → see round 1 → tap an answer → next round appears → after 8 rounds → game over screen → tap Try Again → back to title!
💾 Save your progress! 🎉 Congratulations! You built a complete quiz game with pictures, scoring, and high score tracking. That's real programming! But there's one small problem — the high score disappears when you turn the Tab5 off. Let's fix that in Step 7!

Try This! — Challenges

Optional extras if you finish early

⭐ Easy — Change the Look Change the background color of title_page from dark blue (0x1A237E) to your favourite colour. Try 0x4A148C (purple) or 0x004D40 (teal).
⭐ Easy — Different Questions Replace the quiz content with your own theme! Change the image paths and answers in the three lists. Try a "Flags of the World" quiz or "Guess the Animal" quiz.
⭐⭐ Medium — Even More Rounds Add 2 more rounds (total of 10). You'll need to: add 2 more image paths to images, add 8 more answer slots to all_answers (10 rounds × 4 = 40 total), add 2 more correct indices to correct_index, and change the ≤ 8 in check_answer to ≤ 10.
⭐⭐ Medium — Sound Effects If you have a speaker, add a happy "ding" for correct answers and a sad "buzz" for wrong ones. Use the Speaker hardware block inside check_answer's if/else.
⭐⭐⭐ Hard — Colour Feedback After tapping an answer, briefly flash the button green (if correct) or red (if wrong) before moving to the next round. You'll need to use set_style_bg_color blocks and a short delay from System → Time.
⭐⭐⭐ Hard — Countdown Timer Give the player only 10 seconds per round. Use a timer variable and check it in the Loop section. If time runs out, auto-advance to the next round with no points.

Something Not Working?

Common problems and how to fix them

ProblemTry This
Blank screenCheck all widgets have parent=page. In the UI Editor, make sure each widget is inside the correct page.
START button does nothingCheck the CLICKED event handler for start_btn is attached and contains the four blocks (reset variables, call setup_round, screen_load).
Answer buttons don't respondMake sure all four answer button event handlers are wired up and call check_answer with the correct number (1, 2, 3, 4).
Wrong image showsCheck the images list — make sure each path matches the actual file names on your flash storage (capitalisation matters!).
Image doesn't appear at allAre the .jpg files uploaded to /flash/res/img/? Check the path is exactly Q1.jpg.
Score doesn't changeCheck the if condition inside check_answer — is answer_index = in list correct_index get # current_round wired correctly?
High score resets every timeThis is normal for now! Step 7 will fix this with NVS. Make sure nvs set integer "high_score" high_score is inside the if score > high_score block in show_gameover.
Game doesn't advance past round 1Check that current_round is being incremented (set current_round to current_round + 1) and that the ≤ 8 comparison in if else is correct.
Buttons show wrong textCheck that current_choices is set to in list all_answers get # current_round. Then make sure each button gets the right index from current_choices (1, 2, 3, or 4).
